shared_elements: disc placed on/within a humanoid body
small cup-mark-like dots or bosses (A: bosses/knobs; B: cupmarks)
justification: The most specific correspondence is the concentric ringed disc combined with a schematic anthropomorph — in A a ringed disc sits on the torso of a standing carved figure, and in B a ringed disc forms the body of a limbed figure — plus schematic stick-limbed humans and scattered small round marks in both. The biggest difference is that B is a multi-figure narrative panel including boats, weapons and interacting figures spread over a surface, while A is a single monumental frontal anthropomorph whose motifs are arranged vertically on its own body, with no boats or scene of action.
